dc:title: MassPermits — orleans.csv (coverage ended)
dc:description: MassPermits no longer receives building-permit records for Orleans, MA. This feed has stopped and is kept only so its address does not break. The last permit this feed carried was issued 2026-08-31. It is not a current feed and must not be read as one. Live coverage is listed at https://masspermits.com/permits/ and the sources still publishing are itemised at https://masspermits.com/research/coverage. House numbers, owner names and contractor names are withheld; the street field is masked to the street name only.
dc:source: Compiled from public municipal building-permit records published by Massachusetts cities and towns.

columns.name: town
columns.dc:description: Municipality or Boston neighbourhood the permit was issued in.

columns.name: trade
columns.dc:description: Normalised trade classification assigned by MassPermits.

columns.name: issued_date
columns.dc:description: Date the municipality records the permit as issued.

columns.name: street_masked
columns.dc:description: Street name only. The house number is removed.

columns.name: valuation
columns.dc:description: Declared project value in USD. Empty when the source publishes none.
